sentences.text: Debika Mitra @ Debika Das vs Pintu Das on 11 March, 2025

Author: Hiranmay Bhattacharyya
Bench: Hiranmay Bhattacharyya
 Sl.101
11.03.2025
Court No.6 Bp C.O. 500 of 2025 Debika Mitra @ Debika Das
-versus-
Pintu Das Mr. Sujoy Sarkar Ms. Sneha Srivastava Ms. Debolina Goswami ... for the petitioner

This application under Section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure is at the instance of the wife praying for transfer of the Matrimonial Suit No. 82 of 2024 pending before the learned Additional District Judge, Chanchal, Malda to the Court of learned District Judge at Suri, Birbhum.

It has been submitted by the learned advocate for the petitioner that prior to the filing of the matrimonial suit a proceeding under Section 498A/323/34 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 3 / 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act was initiated at Suri Police Station Case No. 49 of 2024 dated 30th January, 2024 and the same is pending before the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Suri.

entities.text: Suri Police Station Case No. 49 of 2024
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: He further submits that the proceeding under Section 125 of the Criminal Procedure Code was also filed prior to the filing of the matrimonial suit and the same is pending before the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate at Suri being Miscellaneous Case No. 44 of 2024.

The petitioner is directed to serve a copy of this application upon the opposite parties by registered speed post with acknowledgement due and file an affidavit of service on the next date.
List this matter under the heading "Contested Application" in the Monthly List of May, 2025.

(Hiranmay Bhattacharyya, J.)
